filter: 출생연도 1940 이상 또는 미상, 성은 KOSIS 2015 성씨표(복성 우선), 이름 1~2음절

queries.han: SELECT ?p ?zh ?lang WHERE { ?p wdt:P27 wd:Q884; wdt:P31 wd:Q5. { ?p rdfs:label ?zh } UNION { ?p skos:altLabel ?zh } BIND(LANG(?zh) AS ?lang) FILTER(?lang IN ("zh","zh-hant","zh-tw","zh-hk","zh-hans","zh-cn","ko","ko-kore","ja")) FILTER(REGEX(STR(?zh), "^[\u4e00-\u9fff\uf900-\ufaff]{2,4}$")) }
queries.ko: SELECT ?p ?ko (MIN(YEAR(?b)) AS ?y) WHERE { ?p wdt:P27 wd:Q884; wdt:P31 wd:Q5; rdfs:label ?ko. FILTER(LANG(?ko)="ko") OPTIONAL { ?p wdt:P569 ?b } } GROUP BY ?p ?ko
